records.source: Well hello there! I'm Gus, chef and owner of the Stardrop Saloon.#$e#Stop in if you need any refreshments. I've always got hot coffee and cold beer at the ready.$h
records.translation: 你好啊！我是格斯，星之果實酒館的主廚兼老闆。#$e#需要吃喝時就進來坐坐。我這裡隨時備有熱咖啡和冰啤酒。$h

records.source: Oh wow, thank you! I'm tempted to drink all of it, but I'm going to save some for the saloon. I bet I could make an interesting cocktail with this!
records.translation: 喔，哇，謝謝你！我真想全部喝掉，不過會留一些給酒館用。拿這個一定能調出有趣的雞尾酒！

records.source: *sniff*... Ah. Exquisite cuisine. You know what I like, @.$h
records.translation: *聞聞*……啊，精緻的料理。你很懂我的喜好，@。$h

records.source: *sniff* sniff* ... that sharp smell!#$b#*slurp* *slurp* ... that zesty taste! That gritty texture!#$b#It can only be gourmet tomato salt! I'll trade you for it.
records.translation: *聞聞* *聞聞*……這股辛烈氣味！#$b#*舔舔* *舔舔*……這鮮明的滋味！這粗礫的口感！#$b#肯定是特製番茄鹽！我拿東西跟你交換。

records.source: I saw the weather report last night. It really gave me a scare!$s#$e#Are there monsters out there? What's happening?
records.translation: 昨晚我看了氣象報告，真的嚇了一大跳！$s#$e#外面有怪物嗎？到底發生什麼事？

records.source: I'm glad that's over. Running the saloon is enough to worry about, I don't need exotic weather in my life!
records.translation: 真高興一切都結束了。經營酒館已經夠讓人操心，我的生活不需要再來這種怪天氣！

records.source: *sniff*... These rains have a particular smell. Have you noticed? Almost like freshly minced herbs...
records.translation: *聞聞*……這種雨帶著一股特殊氣味。你注意到了嗎？幾乎像剛切碎的香草……

records.source: Lewis tells me your tomatoes have ripened. That's great news!#$b#...Just imagine what the culinary world would be like without tomatoes...
records.translation: 路易斯告訴我，你的番茄成熟了。真是好消息！#$b#……想像一下，沒有番茄的料理世界會是什麼模樣……

records.source: It's important to me that people can eat healthy, delicious meals. Unfortunately, in today's world, that's not so easy for everyone.
records.translation: 讓大家都能享用健康美味的餐點，對我而言很重要。可惜在如今的世界裡，並非人人都能輕易做到。

records.source: Hey @, just want to say that I'm happy for you and %spouse.
records.translation: 嘿，@，我只想說，真替你和%spouse感到高興。

records.source: Emily has a real pep in her step lately... I wonder why? *wink*
records.translation: 艾蜜莉最近走起路來特別有精神……不知道為什麼？*眨眼*

records.source: Hey, I'm sorry to hear about the break-up...$s#$e#If you need company, you're always welcome at the Saloon.
records.translation: 嘿，聽說你們分開了，我很遺憾……$s#$e#若需要有人陪伴，星之果實酒館隨時歡迎你。

records.source: Another failed marriage? Well, it happens. Guess I'll be seeing you at the Saloon more often...$s
records.translation: 又一段婚姻失敗了？唉，這種事難免發生。看來我會更常在酒館見到你……$s

records.source: Hey, you really pulled through with those eggs. The omelet turned out great, thanks to you!
records.translation: 嘿，那些蛋你真的幫了大忙。多虧有你，歐姆蛋做得非常成功！

records.source: Hey, @! Glad you're here. I'm gonna be serving up some good stuff from behind the bar.
records.translation: 嘿，@！很高興你來了。我會在吧檯後面供應一些好東西。

records.source: Meet me at the bar if you need a beverage.
records.translation: 想喝點東西，就到吧檯來找我。

records.source: Hey, need a drink? I've got some special beverages that showcase local ingredients from this island.$h
records.translation: 嘿，想喝一杯嗎？我這裡有些特製飲品，能展現這座島嶼的在地食材。$h

records.source: These might be the best crab cakes I've ever made...
records.translation: 這些或許是我做過最美味的蟹餅……
